tasks.subject: Task 1: Add 138Ba19F boson X0+A0 to molecule_parameters.py
tasks.description:
**Goal:** DB entries so get_molecule_params('BaF','X'|'A',0,'boson') returns spec §4 constants.

**Files:** Modify Source Code/molecule_parameters.py (replace dead stub line `# molecules['BaF']['boson']['X0'] = {` ~line 70 with the two spec §4 dicts, MHz-direct).

**Acceptance:** get_molecule_params('BaF','X',0,'boson') -> bF≈66.2503, c==8.224, Be==6473.9588; ('BaF','A',0,'boson') -> Be==6347.847 (no -2Lam^2D), p+2q==-7719.00 (spec said -7718.99: hand-add slip), a==29.32, d==-3.58, Origin==11946.109609+6347.847/c (N2 T0,0 + Be_A G-row, not formalism:'N2', not Be_X); no KeyError; RaF/YbOH/CaOH untouched.

**Verify:** conda run -n Structure python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'Source Code'); from molecule_parameters import get_molecule_params as g; x=g('BaF','X',0,'boson'); a=g('BaF','A',0,'boson'); print(round(x['bF'],4),x['c'],x['Be']); print(a['Be'],a['p+2q'],a['a'],a['d'])"

**Steps:** Insert X0+A0 dicts (spec §4 verbatim) -> run verify -> commit.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["Source Code/molecule_parameters.py"], "verifyCommand": "conda run -n Structure python -c \"import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'Source Code'); from molecule_parameters import get_molecule_params as g; x=g('BaF','X',0,'boson'); a=g('BaF','A',0,'boson'); print(round(x['bF'],4),x['c'],x['Be']); print(a['Be'],a['p+2q'],a['a'],a['d'])\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["X dict: bF~66.2503, c==8.224, Be==6473.9588", "A dict: Be==6347.847, p+2q==-7719.00 (spec said -7718.99: hand-add slip), a==29.32, d==-3.58", "A0 Origin == 11946.109609 + 6347.847/c (N2 T0,0 + Be_A G-row by hand; NOT formalism:'N2', NOT Be_X 6473.9588); abs validation deferred to Task 2", "no KeyError; other molecules untouched"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: BaF X-A no-M validation + resolve §3.3 hyperfine residual
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Script asserting X(N=0,J=1/2) F-split≈65.6 MHz and A2Pi1/2(J=1/2,-) F-split≈21.8 MHz (≤1 MHz) + sane no-M A->X BR. The A assertion is the spec §3.3 gate; iterate 'a'/'d' mapping within this task until green.

**Files:** Create Jupyter Notebooks/RaX/baf_xa_validate.py; only-if-failing modify Source Code/molecule_parameters.py BaF A0 'a'/'d' (read matrix_elements.py aBJ 2Pi1/2 element first).

**Acceptance:** runs under conda run -n Structure; abs(x_split-65.6)<=1.0; abs(a_split-21.8)<=1.0; abs(nu_centroid-348666439.0)<=5.0 (confirms N2 Origin/Be_A G-row, spec §5); BR finite/non-negative, each A2Pi1/2(J=1/2,-) level normalized decay spreads over X N=0 AND N=1 summing to 1±1e-6; if 'a'/'d' changed, spec §3.3 STOP-comment updated.

**Verify:** conda run -n Structure python "Jupyter Notebooks/RaX/baf_xa_validate.py" -> ends 'VALIDATION PASSED'.

**Steps:** write script (asserts) -> run (X passes; A may fail) -> if A fails inspect IzLz/T2_2 aBJ 2Pi1/2 element + switch among defined parametrizations until 21.8 -> re-run green -> commit.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["Jupyter Notebooks/RaX/baf_xa_validate.py", "Source Code/molecule_parameters.py"], "verifyCommand": "conda run -n Structure python \"Jupyter Notebooks/RaX/baf_xa_validate.py\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["x_split within 1 MHz of 65.6", "a_split within 1 MHz of 21.8 (spec §3.3 gate)", "abs X(N=0)->A(2Pi1/2,J=1/2,-) centroid within 5 MHz of 348666439.0 — confirms N2 T0,0 + Be_A G-row Origin (spec §5; ~6348 MHz miss = inverted N2/R2, ~126 MHz = Be_X-not-Be_A)", "no-M BR finite, non-negative, normalized=1, spreads over X N=0 and N=1", "spec §3.3 comment updated if mapping changed"]}
```
